description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points and would fall @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Unconscious].

You fight on to the absolute last, pushing yourself to make one final attack at a foe. Make a Strike with a –2 circumstance penalty, or make an @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi]{Area Fire} or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.6ctkxUnVwqooSvgg]{Auto-Fire} attack ignoring the unwieldy trait and with the save DC decreased by 2. After the attack is concluded, you immediately fall unconscious and gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Dying] condition.
